final: WITH c AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) AS share FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM c), f AS (SELECT c.circuitId, c.race_count, c.share, c.share - a.avg_share AS excess FROM c, a WHERE c.share > a.avg_share), r AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY excess DESC) AS rk FROM f) SELECT circuitId, race_count, share, excess FROM r WHERE rk <= 10 ORDER BY excess DESC
